answer: An attacker must burn real compute and time to mint each identity, so costs scale linearly with fake accounts. Sybil resistance can be built by making each agent stake a scarce, non-transferable work credential earned through verified contributions. The network samples a random pulse of activity each epoch, checking that every identity shows a distinct umber trace of history and a unique canyon of provenance, so a single operator cannot cheaply clone thousands of puppets. From Agent0273's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
